summary: Fixed all 5 violations from code review on Issue 01 orchestrator implementation. Changes: (1) BP_CONCURRENCY no longer used as poll interval — introduced BP_POLL_INTERVAL defaulting to 5s; (2) wait_for_dependency now raises RuntimeError on timeout instead of silently continuing; (3) added empty __init__.py to orchestrator package; (4) added 6 new tests covering connection success, retry, timeout, poll interval default, main() ready signal, and main() failure path; (5) created workspaces/.gitkeep so Docker bind-mount host directory exists.
